title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Management of Seals of Local People's Courts at Various Levels and Special People's Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Provisions on the Management of Seals of Local People's Courts and Special People's Courts

Fa Fa [2002] No. 10

Pursuant to the Organic Law of the People's Courts of the People's Republic of China and the National Emblem Law of the People's Republic of China, the following provisions are hereby made anew on the style, specifications, issuance, and management of seals of people's courts at all levels:

1. Style of Seals

(1) The seals of local people's courts and special people's courts shall be circular, with the national emblem in the center, and the official name of the people's court inscribed outside the national emblem in a circle from left to right.

(2) The steel seals of local people's courts and special people's courts shall be circular, with a five-pointed star in the center, and the official name of the people's court inscribed outside the five-pointed star in a circle from left to right.

(3) The seals of divisions, offices (chambers, bureaus, departments, sections, and people's tribunals; the same below) of local people's courts and special people's courts shall be circular, with a five-pointed star in the center, and the official name of the people's court inscribed outside the five-pointed star. The name of the people's court shall be inscribed in a circle from left to right, and the name of the division or office shall be inscribed horizontally from left to right.

For the seal of the general office, there shall be a circle with an opening at the bottom in the center, with the words "General Office" vertically inscribed protruding through the opening of the circle, and the name of the people's court inscribed outside the circle in a circle from left to right.

2. Specifications of Seals

(1) The seal of a Higher People's Court shall have a diameter of 5 cm; the seal of an Intermediate People's Court shall have a diameter of 4.7 cm; the seal of a Primary People's Court shall have a diameter of 4.5 cm.

(2) The steel seal of a local people's court or special people's court shall have a diameter of 4 cm.

(3) The seal of a division or office of a local people's court or special people's court shall have a diameter of 4 cm.

(4) The seal of a people's tribunal established by a Primary People's Court shall have a diameter of 4.2 cm.

3. Name on Seals

(1) The seal of a Higher People's Court shall bear the name "XX Province (Autonomous Region, Municipality Directly under the Central Government) Higher People's Court"; the seal of an Intermediate People's Court shall bear the name "XX Province (Autonomous Region) XX City (Prefecture, Autonomous Prefecture, League) Intermediate People's Court"; the seal of a Primary People's Court shall bear the name "XX City (County, Autonomous County, Banner, Autonomous Banner) People's Court" or "XX City XX District People's Court".

(2) The seal of a Maritime Court shall bear the name "XX Maritime Court"; the seal of a Railway Transport Court shall bear the name "XX Railway Transport Intermediate Court" or "XX Railway Transport Court"; the seal of a Forestry Court shall bear the name "XX Province XX City (Prefecture, Autonomous Prefecture, League) Forestry Intermediate Court" or "XX Forestry Court".

(3) The steel seal of a local people's court or special people's court shall bear the official name of the people's court.

(4) The seal of a division or office of a people's court at any level shall bear the name of the people's court and the official name of the division or office.

(5) The seal of a people's tribunal shall bear the name "XX City (County, Autonomous County, Banner, Autonomous Banner) People's Court XX People's Tribunal"; for a people's tribunal established by a people's court of a city district, its seal shall bear the name "XX City XX District People's Court XX People's Tribunal".

4. Script, Font, and Material of Seals

(1) The seals of people's courts in ethnic autonomous areas shall bear both Chinese characters and the commonly used ethnic script of the locality.

(2) Chinese characters inscribed on seals shall use the simplified characters promulgated by the State Council, with the Song typeface.

(3) If the number of characters to be inscribed on a seal is too large to be engraved clearly, commonly accepted abbreviations may be appropriately adopted.

(4) The material of the seal shall be determined by the issuing authority based on actual needs.

5. Issuance of Seals

(1) The seals of local people's courts and special people's courts shall be issued by the Supreme People's Court; the reproduction seals and seal impressions used by people's courts for printing documents and notices shall have the same specifications, style, name, and script as the official seals and shall also be issued by the Supreme People's Court.

(2) The steel seals of local people's courts and special people's courts shall be issued by the Higher People's Court.

(3) The seals of divisions and offices of people's courts at all levels shall be made by the respective people's courts.

(4) The seals of people's tribunals shall be issued by the Higher People's Court.

6. Engraving, Management, and Cancellation of Seals

(1) The court issuing the seal shall standardize and strengthen the management of seal issuance, and strictly follow the processing procedures and approval formalities. The enterprise undertaking the engraving of the seal shall be an engraving unit designated by the local public security authority and must obtain the entrustment of the people's court before engraving the seal. Any forgery of seals or use of forged seals shall be punished according to law.

(2) Seals sent by mail shall be sent through confidential channels or by a specially assigned person.

(3) Seals shall be kept in a safe and secure place, with strict preventive measures.

(4) Local people's courts and special people's courts must establish and improve seal management systems, strengthen the management of seal use, and strictly follow approval procedures. Without approval from the leadership, the unit's seal shall not be used without authorization. Use of the court seal shall be approved by the presiding judge in charge; use of a division or office seal shall be approved by the leader of the division or office. No seal shall be affixed to blank documents. When using a reproduction seal, the person in charge of seal custody shall supervise the sealing. Without special reasons and approval, seals shall not be taken outside the court for use.

(5) Before a new seal is issued, with the approval of the people's court at the next higher level, the old seal or the seal of another people's court at the same level may be temporarily used as a substitute; however, the seal of a division or office shall not be used to replace the seal of a people's court.

(6) Before a new seal is brought into use, the issuing unit shall reserve an impression of the seal. When a new seal is brought into use, the relevant departments shall be informed, and the old seal shall be declared invalid at the same time.

(7) Invalidated seals shall be promptly returned to the issuing court for sealing and storage or destruction. Seals issued by the Supreme People's Court shall be sealed and stored by the Higher People's Court and destroyed after approval by the Supreme People's Court.

(8) Illegal use of seals, or loss or theft of seals due to poor management, shall be seriously investigated and dealt with.

7. The management and use of seals of the Military Court of the Chinese People's Liberation Army shall be separately provided.

8. If any previous provisions on seal management are inconsistent with these Provisions, these Provisions shall prevail.

May 22, 2002
